from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Date, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
from .transaction import Base
import datetime

class Salary(Base):
    __tablename__ = "salaries"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    date = Column(Date, nullable=False, index=True)
    month_reference = Column(String(50))
    employer = Column(String(255))
    employee_name = Column(String(255))
    employee_id = Column(String(50))
    
    # Financial Summaries
    net_income = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    total_earnings = Column(Float) # Tot. Competenze
    total_deductions = Column(Float) # Tot. Trattenute
    gross_taxable = Column(Float) # Imponibile Fiscale
    
    # Metadata
    filename = Column(String(255))
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=lambda: datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc))

    # Relationships
    items = relationship("SalaryItem", back_populates="salary", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    leaves = relationship("SalaryLeave", back_populates="salary", cascade="all, delete-orphan")

class SalaryItem(Base):
    __tablename__ = "salary_items"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    salary_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("salaries.id"))
    
    code = Column(String(20))
    description = Column(String(255))
    base_data = Column(Float)
    earnings = Column(Float) # Competenze
    deductions = Column(Float) # Trattenute

    salary = relationship("Salary", back_populates="items")

class SalaryLeave(Base):
    __tablename__ = "salary_leaves"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    salary_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("salaries.id"))
    
    leave_type = Column(String(50)) # Ferie, ROL, Banca Ore
    previous_residue = Column(Float) # Res. A.P.
    accrued = Column(Float) # Mat. Anno
    used = Column(Float) # Goduto
    remaining = Column(Float) # Residuo

    salary = relationship("Salary", back_populates="leaves")

def to_float(val: str) -> float:
    if not val: return 0.0
    val = val.strip()
    if val.endswith('-'):
        val = '-' + val[:-1]
    return float(val.replace(".", "").replace(",", "."))

def parse_improved(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    extracted = {
        "employer": "ITT ITALIA S.r.l.",
        "employee_name": "Unknown",
        "net_income": 0.0,
        "total_earnings": 0.0,
        "total_deductions": 0.0,
        "month_reference": "Unknown",
        "items": [],
        "leaves": []
    }
    
    # 1. Basic Fields
    patterns = {
        "month_ref": r"([A-Za-z]+\s+\d{4})\s+Pagina\s+1",
        "employee_name": r"Sig\.\s+([A-Z\s]+)\s+\d{4}"
    }
    
    for key, pattern in patterns.items():
        match = re.search(pattern, text)
        if match:
            if key == "month_ref": 
                extracted["month_reference"] = match.group(1)
            elif key == "employee_name": 
                extracted["employee_name"] = match.group(1).strip()

    # Specialized extractions for values that are aligned vertically
    
    # 1. Tot.Comp. and Tot.Trat.
    # We look for the labels and then the numbers on the following line.
    tot_header_pattern = r"Tot\.Comp\.\s+Tot\.Trat\."
    tot_header_match = re.search(tot_header_pattern, text)
    if tot_header_match:
        # Get text after header
        after_header = text[tot_header_match.end():].strip()
        # Find first line with numbers
        lines_after = after_header.split('\n')
        for l in lines_after:
            nums = re.findall(r"[\d\.,]+", l)
            if len(nums) >= 2:
                extracted["total_earnings"] = to_float(nums[0])
                extracted["total_deductions"] = to_float(nums[1])
                break

    # 2. Netto in busta
    netto_header_pattern = r"Netto in busta"
    netto_header_match = re.search(netto_header_pattern, text)
    if netto_header_match:
        after_netto = text[netto_header_match.end():].strip()
        lines_after = after_netto.split('\n')
        for l in lines_after:
            nums = re.findall(r"[\d\.,]+", l)
            if nums:
                extracted["net_income"] = to_float(nums[-1])
                break

    # 2. Parsing Items
    lines = text.split('\n')
    start_parsing_items = False
    stop_parsing_items = False
    
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if "Cod. Descrizione" in line:
            start_parsing_items = True
            continue
        if "Ferie BancaOr" in line or "Tot.Comp." in line:
            stop_parsing_items = True
        
        if start_parsing_items and not stop_parsing_items and line:
            code_match = re.match(r"^([A-Z0-9/]{4})\s+(.*)$", line)
            if code_match:
                code = code_match.group(1)
                rest = code_match.group(2)
                
                parts = rest.split()
                numbers = []
                
                processed_idx = len(parts)
                for i in range(len(parts) - 1, -1, -1):
                    part = parts[i]
                    if re.match(r"^[\d\.,]+-?$", part) and re.search(r"\d", part):
                        numbers.insert(0, to_float(part))
                        processed_idx = i
                    elif part == "X":
                        processed_idx = i
                    else:
                        break
                
                description = " ".join(parts[:processed_idx])
                
                is_deduction = code.startswith("/") or code in ["076B", "0786"]
                
                item = {
                    "code": code,
                    "description": description,
                    "quantity": 0.0,
                    "base_data": 0.0,
                    "earnings": 0.0,
                    "deductions": 0.0
                }
                
                if is_deduction:
                    if len(numbers) >= 1:
                        item["deductions"] = numbers[-1]
                    if len(numbers) >= 2:
                        item["base_data"] = numbers[-2]
                else:
                    if len(numbers) >= 1:
                        item["earnings"] = numbers[-1]
                    if len(numbers) >= 2:
                        item["base_data"] = numbers[-2]
                    if len(numbers) >= 3:
                        item["quantity"] = numbers[-3]
                
                extracted["items"].append(item)

    # 3. Parsing Leaves
    leave_rows = ["Res.A.P.", "Mat.Anno", "Goduto", "Residuo"]
    leave_cols = ["Ferie", "BancaOr", "ExFes/Rol", "Fless."]
    
    leaves_data = {col: {} for col in leave_cols}
    
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        for row_label in leave_rows:
            if line.startswith(row_label):
                content = line[len(row_label):].strip()
                vals = re.findall(r"[\d\.,]+", content)
                if len(vals) >= 4:
                    leaves_data["Ferie"][row_label] = to_float(vals[0])
                    leaves_data["BancaOr"][row_label] = to_float(vals[1])
                    leaves_data["ExFes/Rol"][row_label] = to_float(vals[2])
                    leaves_data["Fless."][row_label] = to_float(vals[3])
                    
    for col, data in leaves_data.items():
        if data:
            extracted["leaves"].append({
                "leave_type": col,
                "previous_residue": data.get("Res.A.P.", 0.0),
                "accrued": data.get("Mat.Anno", 0.0),
                "used": data.get("Goduto", 0.0),
                "remaining": data.get("Residuo", 0.0)
            })

    return extracted

    "def to_float(val: str) -> float:\n",
    "    if not val: return 0.0\n",
    "    val = val.strip()\n",
    "    if val.endswith('-'):\n",
    "        val = '-' + val[:-1]\n",
    "    return float(val.replace(\".\", \"\").replace(\",\", \".\"))\n",
    "\n",
    "def parse_improved(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n",
    "    extracted = {\n",
    "        \"employer\": \"ITT ITALIA S.r.l.\",\n",
    "        \"employee_name\": \"Unknown\",\n",
    "        \"net_income\": 0.0,\n",
    "        \"total_earnings\": 0.0,\n",
    "        \"total_deductions\": 0.0,\n",
    "        \"month_reference\": \"Unknown\",\n",
    "        \"items\": [],\n",
    "        \"leaves\": []\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 1. Basic Fields\n",
    "    patterns = {\n",
    "        \"month_ref\": r\"([A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4})\\s+Pagina\\s+1\",\n",
    "        \"employee_name\": r\"Sig\\.\\s+([A-Z\\s]+)\\s+\\d{4}\"\n",
    "    }\n",
    "    \n",
    "    for key, pattern in patterns.items():\n",

    "            elif key == \"employee_name\": \n",

    "    # Specialized extractions for values that are aligned vertically\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 1. Tot.Comp. and Tot.Trat.\n",
    "    tot_header_pattern = r\"Tot\\.Comp\\.\\s+Tot\\.Trat\\.\"\n",
    "    tot_header_match = re.search(tot_header_pattern, text)\n",
    "    if tot_header_match:\n",
    "        after_header = text[tot_header_match.end():].strip()\n",
    "        lines_after = after_header.split('\\n')\n",
    "        for l in lines_after:\n",
    "            nums = re.findall(r\"[\\d\\.,]+\", l)\n",
    "            if len(nums) >= 2:\n",
    "                extracted[\"total_earnings\"] = to_float(nums[0])\n",
    "                extracted[\"total_deductions\"] = to_float(nums[1])\n",
    "                break\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 2. Netto in busta\n",
    "    netto_header_pattern = r\"Netto in busta\"\n",
    "    netto_header_match = re.search(netto_header_pattern, text)\n",
    "    if netto_header_match:\n",
    "        after_netto = text[netto_header_match.end():].strip()\n",
    "        lines_after = after_netto.split('\\n')\n",
    "        for l in lines_after:\n",
    "            nums = re.findall(r\"[\\d\\.,]+\", l)\n",
    "            if nums:\n",
    "                extracted[\"net_income\"] = to_float(nums[-1])\n",
    "                break\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 2. Parsing Items\n",
    "    lines = text.split('\\n')\n",
    "    start_parsing_items = False\n",
    "    stop_parsing_items = False\n",
    "    \n",
    "    for line in lines:\n",
    "        line = line.strip()\n",
    "        if \"Cod. Descrizione\" in line:\n",
    "            start_parsing_items = True\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        if \"Ferie BancaOr\" in line or \"Tot.Comp.\" in line:\n",
    "            stop_parsing_items = True\n",
    "        \n",
    "        if start_parsing_items and not stop_parsing_items and line:\n",
    "            code_match = re.match(r\"^([A-Z0-9/]{4})\\s+(.*)$\", line)\n",

    "                code = code_match.group(1)\n",
    "                rest = code_match.group(2)\n",
    "                \n",
    "                parts = rest.split()\n",
    "                numbers = []\n",
    "                \n",
    "                processed_idx = len(parts)\n",
    "                for i in range(len(parts) - 1, -1, -1):\n",
    "                    part = parts[i]\n",
    "                    if re.match(r\"^[\\d\\.,]+-?$\", part) and re.search(r\"\\d\", part):\n",
    "                        numbers.insert(0, to_float(part))\n",
    "                        processed_idx = i\n",
    "                    elif part == \"X\":\n",
    "                        processed_idx = i\n",
    "                    else:\n",
    "                        break\n",
    "                \n",
    "                description = \" \".join(parts[:processed_idx])\n",
    "                \n",
    "                is_deduction = code.startswith(\"/\") or code in [\"076B\", \"0786\"]\n",
    "                \n",
    "                item = {\n",
    "                    \"code\": code,\n",
    "                    \"description\": description,\n",
    "                    \"quantity\": 0.0,\n",
    "                    \"base_data\": 0.0,\n",
    "                    \"earnings\": 0.0,\n",
    "                    \"deductions\": 0.0\n",
    "                }\n",
    "                \n",
    "                if is_deduction:\n",
    "                    if len(numbers) >= 1:\n",
    "                        item[\"deductions\"] = numbers[-1]\n",
    "                    if len(numbers) >= 2:\n",
    "                        item[\"base_data\"] = numbers[-2]\n",
    "                else:\n",
    "                    if len(numbers) >= 1:\n",
    "                        item[\"earnings\"] = numbers[-1]\n",
    "                    if len(numbers) >= 2:\n",
    "                        item[\"base_data\"] = numbers[-2]\n",
    "                    if len(numbers) >= 3:\n",
    "                        item[\"quantity\"] = numbers[-3]\n",
    "                \n",
    "                extracted[\"items\"].append(item)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 3. Parsing Leaves\n",
    "    leave_rows = [\"Res.A.P.\", \"Mat.Anno\", \"Goduto\", \"Residuo\"]\n",
    "    leave_cols = [\"Ferie\", \"BancaOr\", \"ExFes/Rol\", \"Fless.\"]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    leaves_data = {col: {} for col in leave_cols}\n",
    "    \n",
    "    for line in lines:\n",
    "        line = line.strip()\n",
    "        for row_label in leave_rows:\n",
    "            if line.startswith(row_label):\n",
    "                content = line[len(row_label):].strip()\n",
    "                vals = re.findall(r\"[\\d\\.,]+\", content)\n",
    "                if len(vals) >= 4:\n",

    "                    leaves_data[\"Fless.\"][row_label] = to_float(vals[3])\n",
    "                    \n",
    "    for col, data in leaves_data.items():\n",
    "        if data:\n",
    "            extracted[\"leaves\"].append({\n",

    "                \"previous_residue\": data.get(\"Res.A.P.\", 0.0),\n",
    "                \"accrued\": data.get(\"Mat.Anno\", 0.0),\n",
    "                \"used\": data.get(\"Goduto\", 0.0),\n",
    "                \"remaining\": data.get(\"Residuo\", 0.0)\n",
    "            })\n",
    "\n",
    "    return extracted\n",
